news.title: Citi Revises Digital-Banking Terms for Third-Party AI Agents
news.body: Citi amended its online user agreement covering customers’ access to online and mobile banking, treating third-party AI-agent actions as customer-authorized even when agents contradict instructions or exceed delegated authority. The terms distinguish external agents from Citi-provided agents and allow Citi to terminate external-agent access; applicable law still governs transaction disputes. Customers using these digital-banking services and providers automating access to their accounts must account for those contractual restrictions, rather than assume permission to use credentials also authorizes third-party agents.

news.title: Worldline Shares Fall Up to 20% After Report on Historical Cash Practices
news.body: Worldline shares fell as much as 20% on November 20 after FT reporting described delayed supplier payments and requests for customer cash advances before financial results in the years preceding its 2023 profit warning. Finextra attributed the selloff to that reporting. The reported practices concern corporate working capital; they do not establish a current interruption to merchant settlements or a failure to safeguard merchant funds.

news.title: PayPo Reportedly Hires Banks for Potential Warsaw IPO
news.body: Polish BNPL provider PayPo reportedly hired Citigroup, JPMorgan and Ipopema Securities for a potential Warsaw IPO that could raise several hundred million dollars as early as 2027. The report puts its user base at approximately 2.5 million; the company and banks declined to comment. Size and timing remain unsettled, and the proposed listing does not yet provide fresh lending capital. A prospectus would clarify credit losses, funding costs and the split between growth funding and shareholder sales.

news.title: Chainflip Vault Loses $4.86 Million in Suspected Key Compromise
news.body: An attacker drained $4.86 million from a Chainflip vault in an apparently automated attack involving a suspected key compromise, The Block reported; its price data showed FLIP falling 34%. Final recoveries, customer losses and the operational status of all services remain undetermined. For users and liquidity providers, the unresolved questions concern which keys and services the attacker compromised and whether recovery or compensation arrangements will cover their exposure.

news.title: CBI, Bancomat and Nexi Coordinate Italian Digital-Euro Infrastructure
news.body: CBI, Bancomat and Nexi announced a collaboration to build Italian infrastructure supporting a digital euro. The agreement coordinates infrastructure preparation; it does not launch digital-euro issuance or production payments. The announcement did not disclose investment, implementation dates or participating-bank commitments, leaving Italian banks and PSPs without a confirmed onboarding schedule or allocation of commercial responsibilities.

perspective: Citi’s AI-agent terms and PayPo’s potential IPO frame developments spanning digital-banking access, consumer-credit funding, payment-provider finances and digital-money infrastructure.
